plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Major streaming overhaul — progressive raw streaming without chunked encoding. Tracks start playing within ~5 seconds when prefetched (near instant), ~20-25 seconds for fresh uncached tracks. Fixes playback on Squeezebox Radio, piCorePlayer, and SqueezeClient. Added early prefetch and 2-ahead prefetch for seamless playback.
plugin.creator: schmij97
